title: Complete ROADMAP P2.3–P3.3: accessibility, performance, console features, component quality
body:
Addresses remaining ROADMAP development tasks across P2.3 Accessibility, P2.4 Performance, P2.5 Console Features, P3.1 Component Quality, P3.2 Field Widgets, and P3.3 View Robustness.

### Build fixes

- Fix `unknown` not assignable to `ReactNode` in `SchemaRenderer.tsx` error boundary
- Fix `possibly undefined` narrowing in `data-objectstack/src/security.ts`

### P2.3 Accessibility & Inclusive Design (5 test files, 87 tests)

- Console page-level axe-core audit (`apps/console/src/__tests__/console-accessibility.test.tsx`)
- Screen reader tests for Grid, Kanban, Calendar — ARIA roles, landmarks, keyboard nav
- WCAG 2.1 AA color contrast ratio verification for light/dark themes

### P2.4 Performance at Scale (4 test files, 40 tests)

- Benchmark tests for Grid/Kanban/Calendar with 1K+ and 10K+ record datasets
- View switching state preservation tests (selection, filters, scroll, sort across grid↔kanban↔calendar)

### P2.5 Console Feature Completeness (5 test files + 1 component, 73 tests)

- CRUD e2e, command palette search, theme toggle, responsive layout tests
- New `InlineEditing` component in plugin-grid with save/cancel/validation, exported from package index

```tsx
import { InlineEditing } from '@object-ui/plugin-grid';

<InlineEditing
  value={cell.value}
  field={cell.field}
  onSave={(val) => updateRecord(row.id, cell.field, val)}
  onCancel={() => setEditing(null)}
/>
```

### P3.1–P3.3 Component Quality, Fields, View Robustness (8 test files, 186 tests)

- API consistency audit across exported components (prop naming, defaults, error states)
- Edge-case tests (overflow, truncation, null data, large datasets)
- Field widget validation feedback, extreme inputs (10K-char strings, MAX_SAFE_INTEGER, emoji, RTL), form variant integration
- Empty/loading/error state tests for Grid, Kanban, Calendar views

### Not yet addressed

P3.4 (test coverage increase to 90%), P3.5 (Storybook interactive controls/edge case stories), P4.2 (typedoc API reference, schema playground), P4.3 (Storybook MDX docs, deployment). ROADMAP.md checkboxes not yet updated.
